- **ω₂** (through C, A, P): substituting C and P gives D₂(k−7) = 49 + s − k², so D₂ = −54/7 − 7s/44. Then C′ = (c, 0) with c = −D₂ − 7.
- **Collinearity:** the radical axes AX and AY have equal slopes exactly when b = D₂ + 2c, i.e. b + D₂ + 14 = 0. This reduces to 7 = 343s/220, so s = 220/49.
- Then q = s/h = 11√3/21, and PA = 60√3/21 − 11√3/21 = 7√3/3 ≈ 4.042.
